---
title: "Rapport Analytique des Maladies Tropicales Négligées"
subtitle: "Synthèse intégrée des six produits d'information"
author: "SOP Data App for TVD"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    css: un-style.css
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: true
    fig_caption: true
    self_contained: true
    df_print: paged
params:
  year: 2023
  disease: !r NULL
  country: !r NULL
  indicator: !r NULL
  endemic_data: !r NULL
  numeric_data: !r NULL
  shapefile: !r NULL
  logo_path: "un-logo.png"
---
<style>
/* Reset Bootstrap pour aspect UN pur */
body.html_document {
  font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif !important;
  color: #333 !important;
  background: #fff !important;
}

/* TOC flottant style UN */
#TOC {
  border-left: 3px solid #009EDB;
  background: #F2F2F2;
  padding: 15px;
  font-size: 0.9em;
}
#TOC a { color: #17365D !important; }
#TOC a:hover { color: #C8102E !important; }

/* Titres */
h1, h2, h3, h4 {
  color: #17365D !important;
  font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif !important;
}
h1 { border-bottom: 3px solid #009EDB; padding-bottom: 8px; }
h2 { border-bottom: 2px solid #009EDB; padding-bottom: 5px; }
</style>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi        = 120,
  out.width  = "100%"
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(flextable)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(sf)
  library(viridis)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ---- Palette UN/OMS (fallback si utils non chargé) ----
if (!exists("un_palette")) {
  un_palette <- list(
    blue = "#009EDB", navy = "#17365D", red = "#C8102E",
    green = "#4C9F38", orange = "#FD9A24", yellow = "#FDB714",
    grey = "#55606E", light = "#F2F2F2"
  )
}

if (!exists("un_endemic_colors")) {
  un_endemic_colors <- c(
    "Yes, country is endemic (report required)" = "#C8102E",
    "No, country is not endemic and will not report for this disease" = "#BDC3C7",
    "No, country is known to be endemic but no surveillance system exists or data are not available" = "#FD9A24",
    "Yes, country is not endemic but reports for surveillance/zero reporting" = "#4C9F38",
    "Never endemic" = "#ECF0F1",
    "not applicable" = "#FFFFFF"
  )
}

if (!exists("theme_un")) {
  theme_un <- function(base_size = 12) {
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
      theme(
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold",
                                        color = un_palette$navy,
                                        size = base_size + 4),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = un_palette$grey,
                                        size = base_size),
        plot.caption     = element_text(color = un_palette$grey,
                                        size = base_size - 2,
                                        hjust = 0),
        axis.title       = element_text(color = un_palette$navy),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = un_palette$light,
                                        color = NA),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold",
                                        color = un_palette$navy)
      )
  }
}

# ---- Récupération des données depuis les paramètres ----
endemic_df <- params$endemic_data
numeric_df <- params$numeric_data
shp_obj    <- params$shapefile

# Certains imports ne contiennent que des valeurs numériques et aucun statut
# catégoriel d'endémicité ; conserver le rapport exploitable sans inventer de statut.
if (!is.null(endemic_df) && !"endemicity_status" %in% names(endemic_df)) {
  endemic_df$endemicity_status <- NA_character_
}
for (nm in c("endemic_df", "numeric_df")) {
  current <- get(nm)
  if (!is.null(current) && !"country" %in% names(current) && "country_iso" %in% names(current)) {
    current$country <- current$country_iso
    assign(nm, current)
  }
}

# ---- Filtres actifs ----
sel_year      <- params$year
sel_disease   <- params$disease
sel_country   <- params$country
sel_indicator <- params$indicator

# ---- Helper : filtre endémique ----
filter_endemic <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  out <- df
  if (!is.null(sel_year))    out <- dplyr::filter(out, year == sel_year)
  if (!is.null(sel_disease)) out <- dplyr::filter(out, disease %in% sel_disease)
  if (!is.null(sel_country)) {
    country_col <- if ("country_iso" %in% names(out)) "country_iso" else "country"
    out <- dplyr::filter(out, .data[[country_col]] %in% sel_country)
  }
  out
}

filter_numeric <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  out <- df
  if (!is.null(sel_year))      out <- dplyr::filter(out, year <= sel_year)
  if (!is.null(sel_country)) {
    country_col <- if ("country_iso" %in% names(out)) "country_iso" else "country"
    out <- dplyr::filter(out, .data[[country_col]] %in% sel_country)
  }
  if (!is.null(sel_indicator)) out <- dplyr::filter(out, indicator %in% sel_indicator)
  out
}

# Helper flextable UN-style
ft_un <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  knitr::kable(as.data.frame(df), format = "html", caption = caption,
               escape = TRUE, table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover"') |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, position = "center")
}




```

    <div>Référence : TVD/RPT/`r format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")`/`r sprintf("%03d", sample(1:999, 1))`</div>
    <div>Date : `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")`</div>
  </div>
</div>


Résumé exécutif {-}
::: {.un-summary}
Ce rapport présente une synthèse analytique intégrée des indicateurs
de surveillance des Maladies Tropicales Négligées (MTN) à partir
des données consolidées de la plateforme TVD. Il couvre les six produits
d'information standard : cartographie de l'endémicité, synthèses
statistiques, détails pivot, tendances temporelles, comparaisons
inter-pays et représentations géographiques.

Filtres appliqués au présent rapport :

Année : `r sel_year %||% "Toutes"`
Maladie : `r paste(sel_disease %||% "Toutes", collapse = ", ")`
Pays : `r paste(sel_country %||% "Tous", collapse = ", ")`
Indicateur : `r paste(sel_indicator %||% "Tous", collapse = ", ")`

:::

```{r}

if (!is.null(endemic_df)) {
  df_f <- filter_endemic(endemic_df)
  n_countries <- length(unique(df_f$country))
  n_diseases  <- length(unique(df_f$disease))
  n_endemic   <- sum(grepl("^Yes", df_f$endemicity_status), na.rm = TRUE)
  pct_endemic <- round(100 * n_endemic / max(nrow(df_f), 1), 1)

  cat(sprintf('
<div class="kpi-grid">
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-blue">
    <div class="kpi-value">%d</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Pays couverts</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-navy">
    <div class="kpi-value">%d</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Maladies surveillées</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-red">
    <div class="kpi-value">%d</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Observations endémiques</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-green">
    <div class="kpi-value">%s%%</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Taux d\'endémicité</div>
  </div>
</div>', n_countries, n_diseases, n_endemic, pct_endemic))
}


```

Produit 1 — Carte de chaleur de l'endémicité
Méthodologie
La heatmap d'endémicité croise les pays (axe vertical) avec les
maladies (axe horizontal) pour l'année `r sel_year`. Chaque cellule est
colorée selon le statut d'endémicité officiel déclaré par le pays à l'OMS.

Visualisation

```{r}
df_hm <- filter_endemic(endemic_df)

if (is.null(df_hm) || !nrow(df_hm)) {
  cat("⚠️ *Aucune donnée d'endémicité disponible pour les filtres sélectionnés.*")
} else {
  ggplot(df_hm, aes(x = disease, y = country, fill = endemicity_status)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = un_endemic_colors,
                      name = "Statut d'endémicité",
                      na.value = "#FFFFFF") +
    labs(
      title    = "Carte de chaleur de l'endémicité des MTN",
      subtitle = sprintf("Année %s — %d pays × %d maladies",
                         sel_year,
                         length(unique(df_hm$country)),
                         length(unique(df_hm$disease))),
      x = NULL, y = NULL,
      caption = "Source : Déclarations officielles OMS / GNARF"
    ) +
    theme_un() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
}

```

Produit 2 — Synthèse statistique de l'endémicité
Tableau de synthèse

```{r}

df_syn <- filter_endemic(endemic_df)

if (!is.null(df_syn) && nrow(df_syn)) {
  summary_tbl <- df_syn |>
    mutate(is_endemic = grepl("^Yes", endemicity_status)) |>
    group_by(disease) |>
    summarise(
      `Pays couverts`       = n_distinct(country),
      `Pays endémiques`     = sum(is_endemic, na.rm = TRUE),
      `% endémiques`        = round(100 * sum(is_endemic, na.rm = TRUE) /
                                     n_distinct(country), 1),
      `Statuts distincts`   = n_distinct(endemicity_status),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(`Pays endémiques`))

  ft_un(summary_tbl,
        caption = sprintf("Tableau 1 — Synthèse de l'endémicité par maladie (%s).",
                          sel_year))
} else {
  cat("⚠️ *Données insuffisantes pour la synthèse.*")
}


```


Répartition globale


Répartition globale
```{r}

if (!is.null(df_syn) && nrow(df_syn)) {
  df_syn |>
    mutate(is_endemic = grepl("^Yes", endemicity_status)) |>
    group_by(disease) |>
    summarise(n = sum(is_endemic, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |>
    head(15) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(disease, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = un_palette$red, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2,
              color = un_palette$navy, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top 15 des MTN par nombre de pays endémiques",
         subtitle = sprintf("Année %s", sel_year),
         x = NULL, y = "Nombre de pays endémiques") +
    theme_un() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
}


```


#Produit 3 — Détail pivot par pays et maladie
```{r}

df_det <- filter_endemic(endemic_df)

if (!is.null(df_det) && nrow(df_det)) {
  pivot_tbl <- df_det |>
    select(country, disease, endemicity_status) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = disease,
                values_from = endemicity_status,
                values_fn = ~ paste(unique(.x), collapse = "; "))

  # Limite d'affichage pour lisibilité
  if (ncol(pivot_tbl) > 12) {
    pivot_tbl <- pivot_tbl[, 1:12]
    cat("ℹ️ *Affichage limité aux 11 premières maladies pour lisibilité.*\n\n")
  }

  ft_un(head(pivot_tbl, 40),
        caption = sprintf("Tableau 2 — Détail pivot pays × maladies (%s).",
                          sel_year))
} else {
  cat("⚠️ *Aucune donnée pivot disponible.*")
}

```


# Produit 4 — Tendance temporelle des indicateurs
## Évolution multi-annuelle

```{r}
df_tr <- filter_numeric(numeric_df)

if (is.null(df_tr) || !nrow(df_tr)) {
  cat("⚠️ *Aucune donnée numérique pour la tendance.*")
} else {
  top_ind <- df_tr |>
    group_by(indicator) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |>
    head(6) |>
    pull(indicator)

  df_tr |>
    filter(indicator %in% top_ind) |>
    group_by(year, indicator) |>
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = indicator, group = indicator)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(big.mark = " ")) +
    labs(
      title = "Tendance temporelle des principaux indicateurs",
      subtitle = sprintf("Top 6 indicateurs — jusqu'en %s", sel_year),
      x = "Année", y = "Valeur agrégée",
      color = NULL,
      caption = "Source : Base analytique TVD"
    ) +
    theme_un() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
}


```

# Table des valeurs annuelles


```{r}
if (!is.null(df_tr) && nrow(df_tr)) {
  trend_tbl <- df_tr |>
    group_by(year, indicator) |>
    summarise(valeur = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = valeur) |>
```

# Produit 5 — Comparaison inter-pays

```{r}
df_cp <- filter_numeric(numeric_df)

if (is.null(df_cp) || !nrow(df_cp)) {
  cat("⚠️ *Aucune donnée pour la comparaison inter-pays.*")
} else {
  ref_indicator <- sel_indicator %||% {
    df_cp |> count(indicator, sort = TRUE) |> slice(1) |> pull(indicator)
  }

  df_cp |>
    filter(indicator == ref_indicator[1], year == sel_year) |>
    group_by(country) |>
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(value > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(value)) |>
    head(20) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country, value), y = value)) +
    geom_col(fill = un_palette$blue, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_comma(big.mark = " ")(value)),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3, color = un_palette$navy) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(big.mark = " "),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      title = "Classement des pays — indicateur sélectionné",
      subtitle = sprintf("%s (%s)", ref_indicator[1], sel_year),
      x = NULL, y = "Valeur",
      caption = "Top 20 pays. Source : Base analytique TVD"
    ) +
    theme_un()
}


```

# Produit 6 — Cartographie géographique
## Carte d'endémicité

```{r}
if (is.null(shp_obj) || is.null(endemic_df)) {
  cat("⚠️ *Shapefile ou données d'endémicité non fournis.*")
} else {
  ref_disease <- sel_disease[1] %||% unique(endemic_df$disease)[1]

  country_candidates <- c("country", "pays", "name", "admin", "name_0", "cntry_name")
  country_match <- match(country_candidates, tolower(names(shp_obj)), nomatch = 0L)
  country_match <- country_match[country_match > 0L]
  country_col <- if (length(country_match)) names(shp_obj)[country_match[1]] else names(shp_obj)[1]

  df_map <- endemic_df |>
    filter(disease == ref_disease, year == sel_year) |>
    mutate(join_key = tolower(trimws(country)))

  shp_j <- shp_obj |>
    mutate(join_key = tolower(trimws(.data[[country_col]])))

  merged <- dplyr::left_join(shp_j, df_map, by = "join_key")

  ggplot(merged) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = endemicity_status),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = un_endemic_colors,
                      name = "Statut",
                      na.value = "#EEEEEE") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Endémicité — %s", ref_disease),
      subtitle = sprintf("Année %s", sel_year),
      caption = "Projection WGS84. Source : OMS / shapefile utilisateur."
    ) +
    theme_un() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
}



```

## Carte d'indicateur numérique

```{r}
if (is.null(shp_obj) || is.null(numeric_df)) {
  cat("⚠️ *Shapefile ou données numériques non fournis.*")
} else {
  ref_ind <- sel_indicator[1] %||% {
    numeric_df |> count(indicator, sort = TRUE) |> slice(1) |> pull(indicator)
  }

  country_candidates <- c("country", "pays", "name", "admin", "name_0", "cntry_name")
  country_match <- match(country_candidates, tolower(names(shp_obj)), nomatch = 0L)
  country_match <- country_match[country_match > 0L]
  country_col <- if (length(country_match)) names(shp_obj)[country_match[1]] else names(shp_obj)[1]

  df_num <- numeric_df |>
    filter(indicator == ref_ind, year == sel_year) |>
    group_by(country) |>
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(join_key = tolower(trimws(country)))

  shp_j <- shp_obj |>
    mutate(join_key = tolower(trimws(.data[[country_col]])))

  merged <- dplyr::left_join(shp_j, df_num, by = "join_key")

  ggplot(merged) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "YlOrRd", direction = -1,
                         labels = label_comma(big.mark = " "),
                         name = "Valeur",
                         na.value = "#EEEEEE") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Indicateur — %s", ref_ind),
      subtitle = sprintf("Année %s", sel_year),
      caption = "Projection WGS84. Source : Base analytique TVD."
    ) +
    theme_un() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}



```

# Conclusions et perspectives
::: {.un-conclusion}
## Points saillants

```{r}
if (!is.null(endemic_df)) {
  df_c <- filter_endemic(endemic_df)
  if (nrow(df_c)) {
    top_dis <- df_c |>
      mutate(e = grepl("^Yes", endemicity_status)) |>
      group_by(disease) |>
      summarise(n = sum(e), .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(desc(n)) |> head(3) |> pull(disease)

    cat("- Les maladies les plus répandues sont : **",
        paste(top_dis, collapse = ", "), "**.\n")
    cat("- La couverture géographique concerne **",
        length(unique(df_c$country)), " pays**.\n")
    cat("- L'année de référence est **", sel_year, "**.\n")
  }
}


```
Recommandations
Renforcer la surveillance dans les pays où les systèmes sont absents ou incomplets.
Harmoniser les définitions d'indicateurs entre GNARF et GHO pour améliorer la comparabilité.
Automatiser la mise à jour annuelle via l'API GHO intégrée à la plateforme.
Partager ce rapport avec les points focaux nationaux pour validation.
